regime_context: The S&P/TSX thematic detector shows Big Banks as the dominant eligible leader with high durability (0.74) but crowded positioning (z=1.33). theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks lead in momentum rank and enjoy high durability and breadth (1.0), and the absolute trend gate confirms an uptrend. The wide rotation margin (0.725) and lack of a confirmed handoff support the staying power of this leadership. Crowding is a size caution, but the trend-following discipline (gate_helps=true) suggests carrying the risk-controlled exposure.
evidence: rank 1 with score 1.455; durability_bar 0.74; eligible true; breadth 1.0
absolute_trend_gate validated for drawdown avoidance on this market (gate_helps=true)
rotation leader with 0.725 margin; no confirmed handoff signal
thematic breadth and durability support a durable leadership structure
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (z=1.33), which historically caps follow-through upside; unscheduled macro surprises (AI/geopolitics) could shift the rate/credit narrative quickly, and the low track-record direction accuracy (0.333) warrants skepticism.

falsifier.text: Big Banks become ineligible (trend gate fails) or durability_bar drops below 0.50, or a confirmed handoff materializes (rotation margin closes and another theme overtakes with durability >0.70).

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas ranks only 7th in momentum, with low durability (0.53) and a mean-reverting Hurst tag, suggesting trend decay. While eligible, its weak durability and limited breadth (0.533) undermine confidence in sustained leadership; the absolute trend gate is less supportive here. Underweight reflects a view that this theme will underperform the leader.
evidence: hurst_tag: mean-revert — price behavior inconsistent with persistent trend
trend gate eligibility alone does not imply strength; durability is below the gate_helps threshold used for conviction
theses.dissent: Geopolitical supply shocks (unscheduled surprises share is 1.0) can spike oil prices and instantly re-rank the theme, invalidating the mean-reversion assumption.

falsifier.text: Oil & Gas durability_bar rises above 0.70 and Hurst tag flips to trend or mixed, or the theme overtakes the leader with a durability-confirmed handoff.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
